answer_findings.lens-sre-code finding 1: sre lens, medium: The DSCLA-9 fixture for the holder's run-status comment is hand-written instead of produced by rsc_render_header, so the test cannot detect a divergence between the writer's format and the reader's regex. (tests/integration/teardown-repeat-signal-test.sh: "cat > "$ZBUILD_CLAIM_STORE/$_DSCLA9_ISSUE/run-status-comment.txt" <<EOF <!-- zbuild-run-status run_id=holder-run-prev --> <!-- zbuild-holder: $_DSCLA9_HOLDER --> run is in progress EOF"; happens when: rsc_render_header changes the <!-- zbuild-holder: --> comment format (e.g. attribute name or surrounding whitespace); the hand-written fixture keeps the old format; _ccgl_read_holder's regex still matches the fixture; the test passes; in production _ccgl_read_holder no longer matches what rsc_render_header writes; runner output stops naming the holder and DSCLA-9 silently regresses. CLAUDE.md requires: "A test makes such data with the writer's own code… never by hand." The writer here is rsc_render_header in scripts/lib/run-status-render.sh.; fix: test)
